:::{#exr-poisson-likelihood}
#### Likelihood of one observation

Write down the [likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-lik-obs)
of a single observation $x$, according to the Poisson model.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-poisson-likelihood}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Lik(\rate; x)
&\eqdef \Pr(X = x)
&& \text{(definition of likelihood)}\\
&= \frac{\rate^x e^{-\rate}}{x!}
&& \text{(Poisson PMF)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
